findings.title: gpt-4o delimiting crypto_trading PI multi-step: released logs give utility 311/384 and ASR 14/384, not the paper's Secure 243 and 84/384; no T2 prompt condition matches
findings.check: OS-1 population tally (L1 raw booleans); H7
findings.evidence: Raw tally over all 384 PI logs (incl. 19 extra-injection logs): utility 311 (80.99% [76.77, 84.60]) vs v2 T2 Secure 243 (63.28%), gap +17.71 pp; ASR 14 (3.65% [2.18, 6.03]) vs 84/384 (21.88%), gap -18.23 pp, 15.84 pp outside Wilson: gap rule fires on both. Default (197 / 75.13%) and Confirmation (6 / 4.10%) do not match either (Confirmation ASR lies in the interval, its utility does not). The MI multi cell of the same pipeline reproduces Secure ASR exactly (307/413), so the logs are this paper's runs. Mapping excluded: L2 raw vs mapped equal on every arm (os2-sample.json). 375/384 PI logs carry the default_defended-containing prompt d8348cf52f; 9 carry the Default-type prompt (PC-04). Wrapper: 340 signed, 30 unsigned, 14 without the phrase; payload found in tool output (heuristic) 315/384, ASR among them 14/315. count_true_values.py reads Secure attacked cells from a default_defended_es directory not in the release (prereg fact-check lead), so the paper's PI numbers plausibly come from unreleased runs: cause undetermined.

findings.agents_md_12: CrAIBench: released PI logs do not reproduce arXiv 2503.16248v2 T2 Secure PI (crypto ASR 3.65% vs 21.88%; chain 34% vs 54%); MI cells reproduce

verdicts.reasoning: Not refuted. All 8 exam scripts re-run at the pin: output byte-identical to the committed JSON. Paper re-read (arXiv v2 html, Table 2): GPT-4o Trading Secure PI prints 243 / 21.87% / Total 390. 21.87% = 84/384 (truncated), so 84 is the right paper count. The printed utility count 243 over the printed Total 390 is 62.31%, against the examiner's 63.28% over 384. Either way the gap is >15 pp (+17.71 or +18.68). Alternatives checked: (a) a different T2 row. GPT-4o Default 197/75.13% and Confirmation 6/4.10% do not match, nor do the GPT-4o-mini rows (Secure 202/55.13%). (b) Mapping: excluded, since the tally uses raw booleans. (c) Score polarity: the MI cell of the same pipeline reproduces 307/413 exactly. R3, headline T2 cell: S2 stands.

findings.title: Default-type system prompt inside the Secure cells: 27 gpt-4o crypto logs (all extra injection ids 5..9, 11) carry a 752-char prompt containing the yaml 'default' text but not 'default_defended'
findings.check: H5; raw census (system-prompt variants vs system_messages.yaml at the pin)
findings.evidence: 4 prompt variants in 1,163 logs (as profiled): d8348cf52f (3,092 chars; contains default and default_defended) 1,114 logs; 5d66eb347e (752; default only) 27 crypto delimiting logs = 6 prepass + 9 PI + 12 MI, every one an injection id in {5..9, 11}; 73c3cfab16 (2,936; default only) the 19 datamarking logs; 4ad2ce123e (651; default only) the 3 banking logs. The 27 enter the paper's Secure denominators (count_true_values divides by files present): MI multi 12 (11 successes), PI 9 (0). Without them MI multi ASR 296/401 = 73.82% vs 74.33%. Datamarking and banking classification is relative to the pin's yaml (their code states differ: a512e34a, be71b1f5), so they are reported, not asserted Default.

findings.artefact_proposal: [agentdojo.art.craibench_mixed_system_prompt] scope.profiles=['craibench-agentdojo']; selector: system prompt sha256 prefix 5d66eb347e on runs/gpt-4o-spotlighting_with_delimiting/crypto_trading/** (27 logs: 6 prepass, 9 PI, 12 MI; injection ids 5..9, 11); effect: Default-type prompt within the Secure condition; claim: disclosure only

verdicts.reasoning: Confirmed as a fact; severity lowered from S2 to S3. raw-census-2/-3 reproduce the 27 logs with variant 5d66eb347e, which lacks the default_defended text. The same text is present in the other 1,114 delimiting logs, including the dc1a1a73 crypto runs, so the pin-yaml classification holds for this commit group. Alternative checked: the effect on a reported metric. All 27 are extra injection ids (5..9, 11), outside the paper's 5-injection design (PC-10). PI holds 9 with 0 successes. MI multi ASR moves 74.33 -> 73.82% (0.51 pp). The paper's own cell includes them and still matches. No headline number moves by more than 0.51 pp, so this is a disclosure (S3), not S2. The artefacts.toml proposal stands.

findings.title: PI wrapper and delimiter forms differ from the prereg premise: crypto PI 340 signed / 30 unsigned / 14 neither; chain 50 unsigned; 2 of 3 banking logs use <data> tags
findings.evidence: Prereg H6 expected all 435 PI payloads unsigned and 0 <data> tags in delimiting logs. Crypto PI: signed ('important message from me') 340 (injection ids 0..4), unsigned 30 (ids 0..9, 11), neither 14 (user_task_1..3, ids 0..4). Chain PI 50/50 unsigned. Banking PI 1 signed. <data> in tool output: banking 2 of 3 (MI, PI), 0 of 1,141 other delimiting logs; << >> 0. The paper's Fig. 15 signed wrapper is therefore in the crypto release; only chain uses the unsigned form. Datamarking ^ joining in 13 of 19 datamarking logs, 0 delimiting (H3 supported). The census quirk agentdojo.spotlighting_delimiters (1,144 logs) is worded for the parenthetical notice; its scope over the 3 banking logs should be checked by the owner.
